白水繞東城 ↔ 'White river winding about them;' — 白水/white river, 繞東城/winding about (the eastern) walls.
此地一為別 ↔ 'Here we must make separation' — 此地/here, 為別/make separation.

孤蓬萬里征 ↔ 'And go out through a thousand miles of dead grass.' — 孤蓬/lone tumbleweed (the drifting Artemisia/fleabane) rendered as 'dead grass', 萬里征/a thousand miles' journey. Corroborating plant crossing: Pound's 'dead grass' fires the en WORD plant boolean on 'grass' (active); zh 蓬 fires zh plant (active) — this line is a plant SURVIVAL, unrelated to the L8 target.
浮雲遊子意 ↔ 'Mind like a floating wide cloud.' — 浮雲/floating cloud, 遊子意/the wanderer's mind.
落日故人情 ↔ 'Sunset like the parting of old acquaintances' — 落日/sunset, 故人情/the feeling of old friends.
揮手自茲去 ↔ 'Who bow over their clasped hands at a distance.' — 揮手/waving hands (Pound: bowing over clasped hands), 自茲去/depart from here.

TARGET. 蕭蕭班馬鳴 ↔ 'Our horses neigh to each other' / 'as we are departing.' — 蕭蕭/the rustling-whinnying reduplicative, 班馬/the parting horses, 鳴/neigh.
